  • Method Details

    • limit

      public GetRecommendationsRequest.Builder limit(Integer limit)
      Deprecated.
      The limit query parameter setter.
      Parameters:
      limit - Optional. The target size of the list of recommended tracks. For seeds with unusually small pools or when highly restrictive filtering is applied, it may be impossible to generate the requested number of recommended tracks. Debugging information for such cases is available in the response. Default: 20\. Minimum: 1\. Maximum: 100.
      Returns:
      A GetRecommendationsRequest.Builder.

    • market

      public GetRecommendationsRequest.Builder market(CountryCode market)
      Deprecated.
      The market query parameter setter.
      Parameters:
      market - Optional. An ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. If a country code is specified, only content that is available in that market will be returned.
      If a valid user access token is specified in the request header, the country associated with the user account will take priority over this parameter.
      Note: If neither market or user country are provided, the content is considered unavailable for the client.
      Users can view the country that is associated with their account in the account settings.
      Returns:
      A GetRecommendationsRequest.Builder.

    • seed_artists

      public GetRecommendationsRequest.Builder seed_artists(String seed_artists)
      Deprecated.
      The seed_artists query parameter setter.
      Parameters:
      seed_artists - Required. A comma separated list of Spotify IDs for seed artists. Up to 5 seed values may be provided in any combination of seed_artists, seed_tracks and seed_genres.
      _Note: only required if seed_genres and seed_tracks are not set_.
      Returns:
      A GetRecommendationsRequest.Builder.

    • seed_genres

      public GetRecommendationsRequest.Builder seed_genres(String seed_genres)
      Deprecated.
      The seed_genres query parameter setter.
      Parameters:
      seed_genres - Required. A comma separated list of any genres in the set of available genre seeds. Up to 5 seed values may be provided in any combination of seed_artists, seed_tracks and seed_genres.
      _Note: only required if seed_artists and seed_tracks are not set_.
      Returns:
      A GetRecommendationsRequest.Builder.

    • seed_tracks

      public GetRecommendationsRequest.Builder seed_tracks(String seed_tracks)
      Deprecated.
      The seed_tracks query parameter setter.
      Parameters:
      seed_tracks - Required. A comma separated list of Spotify IDs for a seed track. Up to 5 seed values may be provided in any combination of seed_artists, seed_tracks and seed_genres.
      _Note: only required if seed_artists and seed_genres are not set_.
      Returns:
      A GetRecommendationsRequest.Builder.

    • min_acousticness

      public GetRecommendationsRequest.Builder min_acousticness(Float min_acousticness)
      Deprecated.
      The min_acousticness query parameter setter.
      Parameters:
      min_acousticness - Optional. For each tunable track attribute, a hard floor on the selected track attribute’s value can be provided. See tunable track attributes below for the list of available options. For example, min_tempo=140 would restrict results to only those tracks with a tempo of greater than 140 beats per minute.
      Returns:
      A GetRecommendationsRequest.Builder.

    • max_acousticness

      public GetRecommendationsRequest.Builder max_acousticness(Float max_acousticness)
      Deprecated.
      The max_acousticness query parameter setter.
      Parameters:
      max_acousticness - Optional. For each tunable track attribute, a hard ceiling on the selected track attribute’s value can be provided. See tunable track attributes below for the list of available options. For example, max_instrumentalness=0.35 would filter out most tracks that are likely to be instrumental.
      Returns:
      A GetRecommendationsRequest.Builder.

    • target_acousticness

      public GetRecommendationsRequest.Builder target_acousticness(Float target_acousticness)
      Deprecated.
      The target_acousticness query parameter setter.
      Parameters:
      target_acousticness - Optional. For each of the tunable track attributes (below) a target value may be provided. Tracks with the attribute values nearest to the target values will be preferred. For example, you might request target_energy=0.6 and target_danceability=0.8. All target values will be weighed equally in ranking results.
      Returns:
      A GetRecommendationsRequest.Builder.
